name: mrs
description: MRS monorepo — renderer-core, scene-schema, renderer-web, ChatGPT App

scripts.setup: pnpm install && pnpm rebuild canvas esbuild
scripts.test:workspace: pnpm run test:renderer && pnpm run test:engine3d && pnpm run test:sovereign-x-router && pnpm run test:chatgpt-app-server && pnpm run test:rt4d-engine && pnpm run test:rt4d-plugin && pnpm run test:rt4d-metering && pnpm run test:genblaze-prompt-scene && pnpm run test:genblaze-engine3d-still
scripts.test:genblaze-prompt-scene: pytest apps/genblaze-media/tests/test_prompt_to_scene.py -k "run_bridge_expand or render_true_real_bridge or post_prompt_to_scene_render_true_real_api or prompt_to_scene"
scripts.test:genblaze-engine3d-still: pytest apps/genblaze-media/tests/test_engine3d_still.py -k "engine3d_still_real_route or api_engine3d_still or health_exposes_engine3d_still or availability_shape"
scripts.test:deploy-smoke: pnpm run test:deploy-smoke:prompt-scene && pnpm run test:deploy-smoke:engine3d-still
